import unittest

from solution import TreeNode, mirror_copy


class DeepTreeTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_valid_deep_tree(self):
        root = None
        for value in range(1500):
            root = TreeNode(value, left=root)
        result = mirror_copy(root)
        source = root
        count = 0
        while source is not None:
            self.assertIsNot(result, source)
            self.assertIs(result.value, source.value)
            self.assertIsNone(result.left)
            source, result = source.left, result.right
            count += 1
        self.assertIsNone(result)
        self.assertEqual(count, 1500)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

import unittest

from solution import TreeNode, mirror_copy


class MirrorCopyTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_empty_tree(self):
        self.assertIsNone(mirror_copy(None))

    def test_recursive_mirror_is_deep_and_preserves_payload_identity(self):
        payloads = [object() for _ in range(5)]
        root = TreeNode(payloads[0])
        root.left = TreeNode(payloads[1])
        root.right = TreeNode(payloads[2])
        root.left.right = TreeNode(payloads[3])
        root.right.left = TreeNode(payloads[4])

        copied = mirror_copy(root)

        self.assertIsNot(copied, root)
        self.assertIs(copied.value, payloads[0])
        self.assertIs(copied.left.value, payloads[2])
        self.assertIs(copied.right.value, payloads[1])
        self.assertIs(copied.left.right.value, payloads[4])
        self.assertIs(copied.right.left.value, payloads[3])
        self.assertIsNone(copied.left.left)
        self.assertIsNone(copied.right.right)

        source_nodes = {root, root.left, root.right, root.left.right, root.right.left}
        output_nodes = {copied, copied.left, copied.right, copied.left.right, copied.right.left}
        self.assertTrue(source_nodes.isdisjoint(output_nodes))

        self.assertIs(root.left.value, payloads[1])
        self.assertIs(root.right.value, payloads[2])
        self.assertIs(root.left.right.value, payloads[3])
        self.assertIs(root.right.left.value, payloads[4])

    def test_single_node(self):
        payload = []
        root = TreeNode(payload)
        result = mirror_copy(root)
        self.assertIsNot(result, root)
        self.assertIs(result.value, payload)
        self.assertIsNone(result.left)
        self.assertIsNone(result.right)

    def test_rejects_invalid_child(self):
        root = TreeNode('root')
        root.left = 0
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            mirror_copy(root)

    def test_rejects_shared_child(self):
        shared = TreeNode('shared')
        root = TreeNode('root')
        root.left = shared
        root.right = shared
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            mirror_copy(root)

    def test_rejects_cycles(self):
        root = TreeNode('root')
        child = TreeNode('child')
        root.left = child
        child.right = root
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            mirror_copy(root)

    def test_rejects_non_node_root(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            mirror_copy('root')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
